title: Are You Not Ashamed to Say "No God"?
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Dastoor ya Sayyidee, madad yaa Rasulullah! Stand up for our Lord, for our Creator! All praisings and all glory
for our Lord, Allah Almighty, from pre-Eternal up to Eternal! O People! Try to be in the Divine Presence, as
much as you can do from praisings and glory to be happy here and Hereafter. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la
ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Allahu akbar kabeera, w'alhamdulillahi
katheera, wa subhaanAllahi bukratan wa `aseela, la ilaaha illa-Llah, wa wahdahu la shareek lah, yuhiyy wa
yumeet wa huwa `ala kulli shayin qadeer. Subhaansen yaa Rabb sultaansen yaa Rabb mutlaq sultaan sensin.
And we are asking humbly from Your Divine Presence to be granted to our most beloved Prophet, our
Messenger Rasulullah, to grant him more and more from Your Glory and Praising. After Allah (swt), who is
that one to whom we may grant our endless glorifying and honoring and praising, is only Sayyidina
Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
As salaamu `alaykum, O our listeners! O human nature, hear and listen, listen and obey, come and listen,
don’t escape, what you can like take it, if you don’t like it leave it. This is such a big market—not flea market,
flea market for me (laughter)—but for you, you are asking something more because you like to make show.
Therefore you are looking for everything to be best one, but I am a weak poor dervish, looking what from

heavens running on Mankind freely. Whole people likes may take and go away; what remaining, I am going
to carry them to collect.
O People! Try to collect what it will be for you forever! Don’t run after something that all of them imitated
one of no value and no existence. It may be that their existence may be continuous up to Day of Resurrection
and after it finished. A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem. O People! Run away from Shaytan and try
to be good ones; if you’re going to be bad ones you will be punished.
Allah (swt) may ask, “O My servant, did you do your best, or not? O My servant, you did your worst or
nothing? O My servant, did you bring your good things granted to you by your Lord? What you did them?
Leaving and coming? Or sending to My heavenly levels for My majestic and glorified lordship? you sent them
to me or you sent to Shaytanic way? What you did, say to Me! I grant to you so many things, everything to be
under your command, to be under your demand, to be under your wishing, under your willing! What you
did? Did you use them in a best way and sending to My Divine Presence, or not?”
The Lord of Heavens, when He is going to be angry, divine anger will come and people beginning to
trembling, even anbiya, even prophets and messengers are falling on their knees for the haybat, for His divine
anger! They're falling on their knees and trembling.
O People! That day is coming. Think on it! Send to your heavenly level what you will have there, that is just
granted to you. (So) send from now for that Day, so you will be granted by your Lord to be for you forever like
a paradise. Send that first. The Lord of Heavens asking, “O My servant, what you sent to My Divine Presence,
tell me? Do you think that I created you like animals that they can’t think anything, or do you think that just I
did My best for you? Of whole Creation, I did My best to YOU, O My servant! Did you do, or are you sending
me your best one? Say to me! I did My best to you, but you are not doing your best for Me! Take this
Shaytan’s followers (to be) with Shaytan!”
Yes, it is enough if Allah Almighty is saying, “O My servant! The Day of Resurrection the same
questioning,” (or) saying to you, “O My servant! Enough, no need any other question.” Think on it! If your
Creator asking you, “O My servant! I did My best to you! Do you think I did My worst to you? What are you
thinking? I did My best to you, but do you think that you did your best for Me?”

That is the question! O pope, say to your followers! O chief rabbi, warn your people! O Muslim world that
they’re trying to be non-Muslims, running after western countries everywhere, and Muslim countries’ people
are saying, “We are asking to be westernized people.” Ptuuh (spit) on you! Who asking to be westernized
people and Allah granting to you highest honor, and you are saying, “We are leaving this and getting to be
westernized people,” what is their honor in the Divine Presence? If you are going to be a westernized people,
what is your honor, what is your value in the Divine Presence? O pope, O patriarchies, O chief rabbis, whole
rabbis, whole bishops, and particularly those Muslim `ulama! I am shouting to them, they’re not opening
their mouth to say, “We are Muslims, and we are only asking our Lord’s pleasure with us, and His pleasure is
only when we are following His holy orders!”
Where is Muslim `ulama? Where is Salafi `ulama? Where is Wahabi people (leaders)? Where is Afghani
leaders? Where is Pakistan leaders? Where is Turkish `ulama? Why you are not warning your people? Allah
likes us to be His servants, not democrats or capitalist or socialist or Shaytanist? Say! Coming some days
now, after a few weeks coming something that going to be beginning of Armageddon! That means: ••••• ••••••
••••••• ••••••••• - inna batsha rabbika la-shadeed - Verily, thy Sustainer's grip is exceedingly strong! (85:22)
Your Lord’s anger coming on people; first on Muslim ones whom asking to be westernized people. They are
leaving everything from Islam and bringing everything from non-Muslims or westernized people. We are not
accepting! We are not accepting! Hah! Keep what we are saying now, O Muslims listeners, and also whole
Mankind. What Allah Almighty calling you and will ask to you, “O My servant, do you think that I did My best
for you?” What it will be your answer to your Lord, for your Creator??! ARE YOU NOT ASHAMING TO SAY,
“We are saying that ‘no god’! We are not going to be ashamed to say, ‘We are atheist!’”
Are you not ashaming to say, ‘We are atheists’?” What is that? O Muslim World, for what you are going to be
70 and more branches (according to hadith) saying of Sayyidina Muhammad (s), “My nation going to leave
my way and they will be in (73) groups. The Lord of Heavens sending His holy orders through myself, and
from my way only one going to be on right way.”
When Allah Almighty asking them, ‘Do you think that I did for you My best?’ only one from 73 branches
going to answer, ‘Yes,’ because all others leaving real way, that the Seal of Prophets (s) just had been ordered
to declare that declaration of heavens to whole nations! Do you think that he was mentioning that one who
will be acceptable? Paradise people—do you ink that they are going to be democratic people or liberal people

or socialist people or communist people or Marxist people or ape-ist... there is ape-ist also? (laughter)
O shaykh, there is new news, that people running after pig flu! They are occupied with pig flu and asking how
to save themselves from pig flu. And one philosopher saying, “O People, try to be pigs, then you will be in
safety because that virus knowing that you are pigs and never touching to you, no need vaccination!”
O my listeners, don’t listen to Shaytan! Shaytan saying, “We like pigs, you should be in safety!” Therefore,
heavenly anger approaching. Approaching when Nimrod was waiting for fighting the armies of heavens, and
he was asking from Sayyidina `Ibrahim (a), “Say where are the armies of your Lord! I am here!”
Sayyidina `Ibrahim (a) saying, “Be patient a little, another word... look, now coming. where they are coming?”
Then just appeared from horizon a small black shape, like black clouds, small one. Sayyidina `Ibrahim (a)
saying, “My Lord’s armies coming so beware, keep yourself!” And Nimrod was very trembling and didn’t
know what to do, looking, looking and surprising! (He was thinking,) “How is that armies of your Lord?”
andafter a while he was asking again, “Where is armies of your Lord?” And when he looked, beginning
sounds coming from the horizon, “Huuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu,” getting up more and more and more
(louder), coming, now arriving to (Nimrod). First the sound was “Hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu,”
making their nervous system finishing! Then a trembling coming on his soldiers dressed in iron armors with
their swords and arrows. Then coming this sound “Hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu,” coming and filling
everywhere. They were falling down without that reaching to them!
O People! I am a weak servant, but making Lord of Heavens to come to my ear the sound of Armageddon;
that taking six (people) from seven and one remaining and six going away. wa maa dhaalika `ala Allahi bi`azeez - and for Allah that is not difficult at all. (14:20)
O `ulama al-Azhar, O `ulama Hijaaz, O `ulama Madinah al-Munawwara, O Iraqi people, don’t do that
explosions! Be quiet! Prepare yourself and try to make tawbah, repent to our Lord, O our Lord, say, O pope,
that your Christian nations are inventing so many terrible weapons, and warn them don’t do this! O People!
the Lord of Heavens never created you to be worst ones to each other, but He ordered to you to be best ones!
Is it true? I am a weak servant; I am nothing and I am shouting! You must hear, you must listen, you must
obey! Or coming, coming, coming Armageddon more than worst!
O People! Don’t think that I am shouting to you, no; to my ego, to my nafs I am shouting and warning, and

everyone may warn their egos because egos always with Shaytan and Shaytan always against Lord’s heavenly
orders. O People! Try what they are making me to say through this holy night, that from your Lord is written
in Old Testament, New Testament, Psalms and Holy Qur’an, and whole prophets that have been granted
heavenly orders, it is written (for them), and everyone knows that Allah Almighty will ask you:
“O My servant, I did My best to you, what do you think?”
(Answering,) “Yes, O our Lord, You did your best.”
(And He will ask,) “You did your best for Me, or not?”
(If there is) nothing else through whole religions, only this enough! This enough only, to know from religions,
from holy books, try to learn this and follow that command, that one day you will be in His Divine Presence
and He is going to ask you, “O My servant, I did My best to you, or not?” Who can say, “No”?
(They must say,) “You did Your best for us.”
“O My servant, tell Me, do you think that you did your best for Me?”
My listeners, where you are escaping you must listen this or heavenly anger approaching and taking away
from every seven (people), six passing away and one remaining. You know! You know! You know! You know!
(Mawlana Shaykh sings.)
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Dome, dome, dome, dome
O Muslims, you are never going to be saved in Divine Presence that when He asking you, “Do you think you
did your best for me?” and you are saying, “O our Lord, we were making high buildings, skyscrapers and we
did everything that western people did in their life; we are doing much more than them.”

Through `ulama of Salafi, where is your amir? O mulook, O kings, O sultans, where is your nasihat, advising
to hujjaaj and your people? And whole Muslim world, stop killing and try to prepare an answer when Allah
Almighty asking to you, “O My servant, I did for you My best. Do you think that you did your best for Me?”
no, nothing
1000s 100 books, no benefit if you cant say, “O My Lord, I tried to make my best for You!”
If you are not learned this, your life going to be suda, wasted, wasted, O People! This is a holy night
and holy anger approaching and making me such a volcano, and I am so fearing from Allah Almighty’s
blaming! O our Lord, forgive us, forgive us, forgive us!!!
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Dome, dome, dome, dome
Dome, dome, dome, dome
I am reaching to 100, I am not asking anything from dunya, from kings or sultans, or other people, no
no. My days going to finish, as well as your days going to finish. I am shouting and warning whole world
people. No one can say against our word that granted tonight to speak to you. Allah Almighty will ask to you,
“O My servant, I did My best to you. Do you think you did your best for Me?”
Finished! Write this down and learn it, or heavenly whip approaching and Armageddon on the doors.
Tawbah yaa Rabbi, tawbah yaa Rabbi, tawbah astaghfirullah, tawbah astaghfirullah! For the honor of Your
best one, forgive us and send us who can keep ourselves, your weak servants, on Your brightened way to
make You happy with us, for the honor of most honored one (s).
Fatihah.
(45 minutes) It is OK. Subhanallah, astaghfirullah.
